title: Sichuan Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with lentils, sichuan peppercorns, and zesty vegetables.

ingredients.name: lentils
ingredients.notes: green or brown lentils work well

instructions: 1. In a small pan, toast the sichuan peppercorns over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
2. Grind the peppercorns into a fine powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
3. In a large pot, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
4. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
6. Add the lentils, vegetable broth, and ground peppercorns to the pot.
7. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
8. Stir in the zesty hot sauce and canned stew.
9. Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
